subject: EdgeHealth - retention configuration & proof-of-privacy pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@edgehealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + asks from today - retention and PII handling

Thanks Alex — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and asks so our legal/security teams can triangulate: 

- Our primary ask: 0-retention of raw patient-identifiable inputs (PHI/PII) from production traffic. We understand there are engineering trade-offs; want to see options (hosted short-retain vs private).
- KV cache: we need clarity on whether any model-serving cache entries (KV / attention cache) persist beyond the request and if so, how long and if they can be disabled or scoped per-customer.
- Embeddings: we will likely use embeddings for search/ranking. Need to know if embeddings can be persisted only in encrypted form, and what retention windows you support (30d/90d/opt-out).
- Residency: data processing & storage must be EU-only for EdgeHealth (primary EU controller). Any fallback regions are a blocker.
- Evidence: SOC 2 report + list of encryption-at-rest keys and KMS options (HSM) are required.

Attached: edgehealth-data-map.xlsx (contains example PII categories + sample payloads).

Next steps from our side: security questionnaire + PO contact (copied procurement). From Redwood: proposed retention paths + short pilot plan and timelines.

Appreciate a short plan this week so we can book legal/security time.

— Sarah
Sarah Collins
Head of Product Ops, EdgeHealth
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 17:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today - retention and PII handling

Thanks Sarah — good to meet the team. High-level responses and a concrete pilot we can run: 

Summary of options (short):
- Hosted short-retain pilot (fastest):
  - Raw request text: 0-retention (we can configure to drop raw inputs immediately post-processing).
  - KV cache: configurable per-deployment. For this pilot we can set KV TTL to 72 hours and enable an immediate purge API you can call.
  - Embeddings: optional; by default embeddings are persisted. We can offer an encrypted embeddings store with a configurable retention (30d/90d) or opt-out to never persist embeddings for certain routes.
- Private/VPC deployment (gold):
  - Full EU-only control plane + data plane in your tenancy; persistent storage under your KMS/HSM. Enables strict zero-retention operational model.

Evidence and operational artifacts: attached SOC2-summary.pdf and a short pilot-proposal (pilot-proposal.pdf) outlining scope, roles, and timeline.

Proposed pilot (2–3 weeks):
1) Security quick-check (we provide SOC2 artifacts + short technical design) — 2 business days.
2) Configure hosted pilot with: 0-retention on raw inputs, KV TTL=72h with purge API, embeddings opt-out.
3) Customer acceptance testing (privacy & feature) — one week.

Immediate asks for procurement: target contract duration for pilot (30 days) and whether a simple MSA amendment works. I’ve looped Dylan (Privacy) and Ben (Sales Engineering) to schedule the deep-dive and to validate the data map.

If this direction looks OK I’ll send a short SOW and a prod-like runbook for the pilot.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attach: SOC2-summary.pdf, pilot-proposal.pdf
From: Mikhail Orlov <mikhail.orlov@edgehealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today - retention and PII handling

Alex — quick clarifying Qs before we book the security call: 

1) When you say "drop raw inputs immediately post-processing", does that include all intermediate logs used for debugging (request IDs, full payloads)? We need guarantee raw payloads are never kept in logs for production.
2) Embeddings: if we opt-out of persistence, are those embeddings still used transiently for caching/optimization? Will any derived vectors be written to disk?
3) KMS: for hosted pilot can you support customer-managed KMS keys (HSM-backed) for encryption-at-rest for embeddings & audit logs?
4) Audit logs: we need an immutable access log for any engineer access to live customer traffic; retention for audit logs needs to be 90 days (for now).

If hosted pilot can't meet (1) + (3) we need to consider a short private deployment pilot.

— Mikhail
Mikhail Orlov
VP Engineering, EdgeHealth
Cc: procurement@edgehealth.ai
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Mikhail Orlov <mikhail.orlov@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today - retention and PII handling

Mikhail — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers + next steps below.

Quick answers:
- Raw payloads & logs: Yes — for the hosted short-retain pilot we can configure the ingestion pipeline to not persist raw payloads. Operational logs will contain request IDs and metadata (timestamp, route, token counts) but not full payloads. For any debug sessions we only retain redacted snippets and session IDs you can cross-reference; full payloads are never persistently stored for this pilot.
- Embeddings: If you opt-out of persistence, embeddings are computed transiently and used in-memory for the request. We do not write derived vectors to disk unless persistence is explicitly enabled.
- KMS/HSM: We support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for hosted private keys (HSM-backed) on dedicated instances. For the hosted shared environment we can support a customer-managed key for embeddings and audit logs in the EU region as part of the Dedicated plan; for the short hosted pilot we can provide envelope-encryption with keys we manage, and a contractual promise on key isolation.
- Audit logs: We can provide immutable, exportable audit logs with 90-day retention. Exports can be delivered nightly to an S3 bucket in your EU tenancy if needed.

Proposed mitigations and options: 
- If you require HSM BYOK + guaranteed EU-only processing with no hosted shared-tenant fallbacks, the minimal path is a short Dedicated trial (single-customer pool) — we can spin up in ~7 business days.
- If you want to validate behavior faster (3–5 business days), run the hosted short-retain pilot with the configuration above and validate via the security deep-dive. If anything is insufficient we’ll convert to a Dedicated trial.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Dylan/Bob run the security deep-dive with EdgeHealth security (30–45m).
2) I’ll share a short SOW + pilot runbook and a checklist for procurement (PO contact, payment terms).
3) Confirm dates — available slots for the deep-dive: Tue 9/7 10:00–11:00 CET or Wed 9/8 14:00–15:00 CET.

Ben / Dylan — can you confirm the technical test plan and what artifacts we need to share ahead of time?

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the proposal link: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/EDG-2026-0042

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
